jobs.title: Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
About CDMS

CDMS is a premier Environmental Health and Safety Consulting company serving clients across California. We provide exceptional EH&S consulting services to help businesses navigate complex regulatory requirements while improving workplace safety and environmental compliance. Join our collaborative team and make a meaningful impact on California businesses. 

The Role

We're seeking an Environmental Health and Safety Consultant
with 2-5 years of industry experience to join our growing team in our Pleasanton, CA office. This role balances experience implementing EHS programs across a wide variety of industries while developing project management expertise. You'll manage EHS consulting projects, solve complex EHS compliance issues and serve as a mentor to junior specialists. 

What You'll Do

Manage EHS projects for our clients providing exceptional client service while maintaining project schedules and budgets. 
Prepare reports for our clients to follow guidance and regulations designed by EPA, DTSC, local CUPAs, Fire departments, Water boards and other federal, state and local government agencies 
Assist with permitting requirements and documentation (air quality, wastewater, Tiered Permitting, storm water, etc.) 
Conducting training for employees of client companies 
Conducting monitoring (air monitoring, soil sampling, etc.) 
Conducting compliance audits 
Providing ongoing compliance support to clients 
Providing various other support activities to clients to assist with their compliance efforts 

What You Bring

2-5 years of experience in environmental consulting or related industry 
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related field (Master's degree a plus) 
The ability to work independently and lead a project team 
A high attention to detail and strong project management skills 
A personable demeanor and professional communication skills, both verbal and written 
Comfortable conducting trainings to groups of 10-40 people (10% of the job) 
Ability to handle multiple projects at the same time 
Computer skills, including proficiency in Word and Excel 

Why Work With Us

Opportunity to advance your environmental career in a role that balances strong technical knowledge with project management development 
Hybrid work arrangement available after initial onboarding period 
Collegial, supportive team environment that values innovation and excellence 
Comprehensive benefits including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, 401K plan (Roth and Non-Roth options) with generous company match & HSA 
Make meaningful contributions that directly impact California companies and help their employees work safely 
Professional development opportunities and support for continued education and certifications 

COMPENSATION

$70,000-$130,000

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

CDMS is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT CDMS

CDMS is a California Environmental, Health & Safety compliance firm with more than 35 years of experience. We help manufacturing, metal finishing, warehousing, and transportation companies meet Cal/OSHA, hazardous waste, air quality, stormwater, and CUPA requirements across the state. Join a collaborative team that makes a measurable difference for California businesses. 

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Environmental Specialist with 2 to 5 years of experience for our Long Beach, CA office, serving clients across Southern California. You will support and coordinate EHS consulting projects, solve compliance challenges, and grow your technical and project skills across a range of industries. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Support EHS projects and coordinate day-to-day tasks, helping keep schedules and budgets on track while delivering strong client service. 
Help develop health and safety programs for client companies. 
Prepare compliance reports and documentation to meet EPA, DTSC, local CUPA, Fire Department, Water Board, Air District, and other regulatory requirements. 
Assist clients with permitting and documentation (air quality, wastewater, stormwater, and related programs). 
Conduct field monitoring (air monitoring, soil sampling, and similar) and support compliance audits. 
Deliver employee training sessions, typically groups of 10 to 40 (about 10% of the role). 
Provide ongoing compliance support to clients. 

QUALIFICATIONS

2 to 5 years of experience in environmental consulting or a related field. 
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. 
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Ability to work independently and as part of a project team. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional, personable manner. 
Comfortable delivering group trainings. 
Ability to manage several tasks and projects at once. 
Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel. 
Valid California driver's license and willingness to travel to client sites across Southern California. 
Bilingual English and Spanish is an advantage. 

WHY CDMS

Advance your EHS career, building both technical expertise and project management skills. 
Hybrid work arrangement available after onboarding. 
Supportive team that values quality work. 
Comprehensive benefits, including medical insurance, dental insurance, and a 401(k) plan (Roth and non-Roth options) with a generous company match and HSA. 
Paid time off starting at two weeks and increasing to three weeks with tenure. 
Professional development support, including continuing education. 
Work that directly helps California companies keep their people safe and their operations compliant. 

COMPENSATION

$80,000-$130,000

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

CDMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.
